intro: Black has just played Nf6. Pick up the white queen on h5 — tap it or drag it.
wrong: Black has an answer to that. The queen goes back; look at f7 — who guards it?
hint: Hint: f7 — its only defender is the king, and the c4 bishop already aims at it.
done: f7 was guarded only by the king, and the bishop on c4 backs the queen. Checkmate.

intro: Black has just played Qc7. Pick up the white rook on e1 — tap it or drag it.
wrong: Black has an answer to that. The rook goes back; look at the squares around the king.
hint: Hint: e8 — the pawns on f7, g7 and h7 leave the king no square to step to.
done: The pawns on f7, g7 and h7 wall the king in, and nothing can cover e8. Checkmate.

intro: Black has just played Rg8. Pick up the white knight on g5 — tap it or drag it.
wrong: Black has an answer to that. The knight goes back; count the king’s free squares.
hint: Hint: f7 — every square around the king is already taken by black pieces.
done: The rook and pawns fill every square around the king, and a knight’s check cannot be blocked. Smothered mate.
